Entries.SkillBook2_Description: Biroz Terimchilik tajribasi olish uchun buni o‘qing.
Entries.SkillBook3_Description: Biroz Konchilik tajribasi olish uchun buni o‘qing.
Entries.SkillBook4_Description: Biroz Jang tajribasi olish uchun buni o‘qing.
Entries.Slate_Description: Suvga o‘ta chidamli bo‘lgani uchun tom yopishga yaxshi materialdir.
Entries.SlimeCrate_Description: Qo‘lga o‘rgatilgan shilimshiqni boshqa joyga ko‘chirish uchun bundan foydalaning.
Entries.Slimejack_Description: U juda qalin shilimshiq qatlami bilan qoplangan. Qo‘lingizdan sirg‘alib chiqaveradi!
Entries.SmallMagnetRing_Description: Buyumlarni yig‘ib olish doirangizni biroz kengaytiradi.
Entries.SmallmouthBass_Description: Ifloslanishga juda sezgir chuchuk suv balig‘i.
Entries.Snail_Description: Spiralsimon chig‘anoqda yashaydigan, keng tarqalgan mollyuska.
Entries.SnakeSkull_Description: Bir vaqtlar ilonga tegishli bo‘lgan saqlanib qolgan bosh suyagi.
Entries.SnakeVertebrae_Description: Bu ilon nihoyatda egiluvchan bo‘lgan ko‘rinadi.
Entries.SnowYam_Description: Bu mitti batat qor ostida yashiringan edi.
Entries.SnowyStone_Description: Tosh, ruda yoki geodalar olish uchun parchalab tashlang.
Entries.Soapstone_Description: Nisbatan yumshoq bo‘lgani uchun bu tosh o‘ymakorlikda juda mashhur.
Entries.SonarBobber_Description: Baliq tutilishidan oldin qarmoqqa qaysi baliq ilinganini ko‘rsatadi.
Entries.SonofCrimsonfish_Description: U yozning iliq suvida tuxumdan chiqqan va otasining izidan borgan.
Entries.SoulSapperRing_Description: Har safar mahluqni o‘ldirganingizda ozgina quvvat olasiz.
Entries.SpangleSeeds_Description: Yozda eking. 8 kunda yorqin tropik gul hosil qiladi. Turli ranglarda.
Entries.SpeedGro_Description: Barglarning o‘sishini rag‘batlantiradi. O‘sish tezligini kamida 10%ga oshirishi kafolatlangan. Yumshatilgan tuproqqa aralashtiring.
